source.layer: I: real TaskService / ManagedTaskCapabilities / session store / projector / actual CJS adapters; harmless executable version scripts, fake process reader/PTY and controlled effective-sandbox fixture. No real Agent process, model or UI.

effectiveOldEvidence.use: Read actual pure CJS planning and immutable projection expectations; not re-counted as new result
Reused real production composition fixture, bounded own-resource cleanup and CLI reference package helper; selected targeted T16 cases only

criteria.criterion: Generate delivery information for the same application SOP with two declared Agent fixtures
criteria.actual: Actual Codex 0.166.0 adapter 1.3.0 and retained Claude Code 2.1.303 adapter 1.0.0 invoked by production TaskService; current mail 1.1.0 MCP package selected for both.

criteria.criterion: SOP content identity does not change by Agent/model; target scope remains identical
criteria.actual: Same package hash, per-Skill original content hashes and source paths, projectId, allowedOperations and connection bindings. Actual projected SOP bytes match after normalizing only native frontmatter name; source package files remain unchanged.

criteria.criterion: Adapters only supply discovery/configuration/context and entry-specific delivery
criteria.actual: Production projector supplies common SOP; actual CJS planner generates Codex -c configuration and Claude --plugin-dir/--mcp-config. No application/business implementation substituted. Scope remains the selected mail application and same project.

criteria.criterion: MCP and CLI supported combinations produce matching declarations and actual launch configuration
criteria.actual: Both declared adapters deliver MCP. Existing controlled read-only mail draft-list CLI reference package uses the same SOP source: Codex final run uses CLI and CLI-only Skill; Claude final run uses declared MCP fallback and MCP-only Skill. Final owned-run plan argv verified present in respective Fake PTY launch; only mail.draft.list is allowed.

criteria.criterion: Unsupported combinations are explicit and do not mutate SOP or expand scope
criteria.actual: Future native version 99.0.0 rejected by both with AGENT_ADAPTER_UNSUPPORTED. Claude CLI injection rejected with same code; original input, SOP byte hashes and fixed snapshots remain unchanged.
